summary.zh: 本次更新修复了技能徽章在对话历史与重试中的丢失问题，并统一了提供商与模型的状态管理，使页面显示与实际运行状态保持一致。
summary.en: This release fixes skill badges disappearing from conversation history and retries, and unifies provider/model state management so the UI reflects the actual runtime.

title.zh: 修复技能徽章在历史记录和重试中丢失的问题
title.en: Fix skill badges missing from history and retries

summary.zh: 技能徽章现在会正确显示在对话历史中，并且在重试或恢复对话时也不会消失。
summary.en: Skill badges now appear correctly in conversation history and persist across retries and restores.

details.zh: 消息记录现在会保存技能列表，历史视图能正常恢复显示。
details.en: Display records now carry the skill list, and history projection restores it on user messages.

details.zh: 重试或恢复提交时会保留技能信息，分叉会话也能正确读取。
details.en: Retry/restore keeps skills when resubmitting, and forked sessions read skills via the fixed projection.

sources.title: fix(session): persist skill badges across history and retries

title.zh: 统一提供商目录与运行时模型状态
title.en: Unify provider catalog and runtime model state

summary.zh: 左侧导航现在基于持久化的提供商目录，删除提供商后界面会正确收敛；设置窗口与所有辅助选择器共享同一份运行时模型状态。
summary.en: The left rail now derives from the persisted provider catalog; deleting a provider converges correctly, and the settings window shares a single runtime model directory with all selectors.

details.zh: 删除提供商失败时保留卡片，不会错误消失。
details.en: Failed provider deletes keep the card instead of disappearing.

details.zh: 异步写入凭据后刷新模型，避免过期快照覆盖新状态。
details.en: Waits for async runtime credential writes before refreshing models to prevent stale snapshots overwriting newer ones.

details.zh: 提供商或模型写入失败时不再显示成功。
details.en: Rejects HTTP 2xx with JSON errors on write paths so failures are never shown as successful.

sources.title: fix(settings): unify provider catalog and runtime model state

title.zh: 持久化模式更新支持技能字段
title.en: Persistence schema updated for skill fields

summary.zh: 服务端数据模式已更新，可存储可选的技能数组，无需迁移数据。
summary.en: The server persistence schema now supports an optional skills array without requiring data migration.

details.zh: 新增字段为可选字段，不影响现有消息结构。
details.en: Additions are additive optional fields within existing message shapes.

details.zh: 数据纪元保持为 1，现有数据无需处理。
details.en: DATA_EPOCH stays at 1, so no migration needed.

sources.title: build(persistence): repin schema fingerprint for skill list fields
